description: # YouTube Video Editor (Educational / Talking Head Content) ## Position Type Part-Time / Ongoing Contractor --- ## About This Role We have an existing editor and are building a reliable, long-term team. This is not a desperate replacement gig — we're looking for someone who can grow with the channel, deliver consistently, and become a trusted part of our production workflow. --- ## Compensation Per-package pricing (no video = no pay): **Starting Rate (Trial + First Month):** - $50 per video package - Includes: - 1 long-form YouTube video (5–10 min final runtime) - 5–7 short-form vertical clips - 1 custom thumbnail **Scaling Rate (After Proven Consistency):** - $75–$100 per package after 4–6 successful deliveries - Based on quality, reliability, and communication **Additional standalone shorts:** - $5 each - $6–$8 if heavier editing or custom graphics required **Payment Schedule:** - Every 2 weeks - Only for packages actually delivered and approved --- ## About The Channel This channel focuses on: - mortgages - real estate - financial education - wealth-building concepts The editing style should feel: - modern - clean - high-retention - professional - trustworthy The goal is NOT gimmicky or overhyped editing. We want viewers to feel: *"Clear, calm, confident guidance."* Style references: - Graham Stephan - Ali Abdaal - Mark Tilbury --- ## What You'll Be Editing You will primarily edit: - talking-head educational videos - financial storytelling content - mortgage strategy content - real-world buyer scenarios Typical long-form videos: - 5–10 minutes You will also create: - YouTube Shorts - Instagram Reels - TikTok clips - LinkedIn vertical clips --- ## Responsibilities ### Long-Form Editing You will: - remove mistakes, pauses, filler words - tighten pacing for retention - add subtle zoom cuts and jump cuts - add clean captions and text emphasis - add occasional b-roll and overlays - integrate provided infographics and visuals - use light background music and subtle sound design - maintain a clean, modern YouTube pacing style ### Short-Form Content From each long-form video: - identify strong hook moments - create 5–7 vertical clips - format properly for 9:16 platforms - add captions and pacing optimized for retention - create clips that drive viewers toward the long-form video **IMPORTANT:** Shorts should feel like previews and curiosity-builders — not full summaries. ### Thumbnails You will create 1 custom thumbnail per long-form video: - clean, modern design - clear focal point - readable text at small sizes - consistent with channel branding ### Visual / Graphics Work You may occasionally: - add simple motion graphics - integrate charts and infographics - use stock footage selectively - organize visuals to improve understanding Most visuals and scripts will be provided. --- ## Editing Style Requirements We are looking for editors who understand: - pacing - storytelling rhythm - educational retention - visual clarity - modern YouTube editing This is NOT meme editing. We prefer: - clean cinematic pacing - calm confidence - modern documentary feel - clarity over flashy effects --- ## NON-NEGOTIABLES ### Accuracy Matters This is financial and mortgage content. All: - text - numbers - names - graphics - statistics MUST match the spoken audio exactly. Editors who consistently miss details will not be a fit. ### Communication We value: - responsiveness - reliability - professionalism - clear communication - consistency If deadlines change, communicate early. Thumbnail finalized We are building: - templates - SOPs - editing systems - reusable assets Goal: Create a smooth long-term production workflow. --- ## Included Resources You will usually receive: - raw footage - script - topic context - visual references - infographic assets - branding direction --- ## Required Skills - YouTube editing - Short-form editing - CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro - Understanding of pacing and retention - Good English comprehension - Ability to follow detailed instructions - Basic thumbnail design Bonus: - motion graphics - advanced thumbnail design - educational content editing - storytelling instincts --- ## Important Notes We are looking for: - long-term relationship - reliability - someone who grows with the channel This role may scale to: - multiple videos per week - additional responsibilities - increased compensation over time based on consistency and quality --- ## Application Requirements Please include: 1. 2–3 YouTube videos you edited 2. 2–3 short-form videos you edited 3. 1–2 thumbnail examples 4. Your editing software 5. Your turnaround time for a 5–10 minute video 6. Your rate per package (1 long-form + 5–7 shorts + 1 thumbnail) 7. Your internet speed 8. description: I run a growing 3D animated faceless YouTube channel modeled on Zack D Films, and I'm hiring a long-term storyboard artist who is the bridge between the script and the final animated short. This is the most important hire on my team — the storyboard is what makes or breaks the video. Main Responsibility — Storyboarding (60% of your time) For every approved script you receive, you'll break it down into small sentences (one beat per frame) and turn it into a storyboard. For each sentence you'll provide: A clear visual instruction (camera angle, character action, expression, environment) A reference image (a screenshot from a similar Zack D Films short, a movie still, or a real photo — anything that shows the animator exactly what you mean) Timing notes if the beat needs special pacing (slow zoom, hard cut, hold-for-laugh) A 3D animator should be able to open your storyboard, look at sentence #14, and animate that frame without asking you a single question. Voiceover Production (15%) Use Elevenlabs to create the voice over then use Audacity to trim the VoiceOver with fullstops, etc. Animator Feedback Loop (15%) Once the 3D animators deliver a draft, you review it against the storyboard. If something is off — wrong camera angle, off timing, expression doesn't match the line — you write clear revision notes with timestamps and (where useful) annotated screenshots. You keep this loop running until the final video matches our quality bar. Channel Management (10%) Upload finished videos to YouTube with the right title, description, tags, thumbnail Schedule uploads on our posting cadence Reply to comments to drive engagement (you'll be given a tone guide) Flag comments that need my attention (sponsorships, collabs, complaints) You'll be given on Day 1: Full Zack D Films scripting SOP, reverse-engineered storyboard reference Zack D Films shorts, animator brief + revision-note templates, channel SOP, voiceover sample reels. ? BIG PLUS — 3D Animation Skills (Higher Pay) If you can also do 3D animation (Blender, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or similar), this is a major plus. I'll send 3D animation work your way on top of the storyboarding role, and your monthly salary goes up accordingly — see the salary breakdown below. If you're a strong storyboard artist AND a competent 3D animator, you're exactly who I want on this team long-term. Who You Are: You've worked on at least one animated YouTube channel before (unpaid passion projects count if the work is good) Strong visual sense — when you read "he slowly opened the door," you immediately picture the angle, lighting, and lens Clear, natural-sounding English. Voice samples required You read briefs carefully and ask clarifying questions early instead of guessing Available for one 30-minute video call per week Can commit 6+ months. No 1-month contracts What this job is NOT: You will not be writing scripts (we have a scriptwriter). You will not be doing the 3D animation (we have animators). You will not be designing thumbnails (we have a thumbnail designer). You will be the bridge between script and animation. That's the whole job. HOW TO APPLY — follow this format exactly: 1. Start your message with the words "Frame 14" so I know you read the full post. 2. Portfolio: 1–3 links to storyboards or animated shorts you've worked on. If you don't have public examples, paste a 10-frame storyboard for this sentence: "I broke my brother's trophy and tried to hide it before he got home — but then I heard his key in the lock." Use any image references you want (Google Image links are fine). 3. Voice sample: A 30–60 second voiceover recording. Drive/Dropbox link, no attachments. 4. Zack D Films question: In 2–3 sentences, what makes a Zack D Films short work? What's the one thing he does that most copycat channels miss? 5. Availability: Your timezone, hours/week you can commit, and earliest start date. Applications that don't follow this format will be ignored. I'm hiring for attention to detail — your application is the first test.

description: About Reformly Reformly is a rapidly growing international e-commerce brand on a mission to help women become the best versions of themselves and feel confident in their bodies. We achieve this through our studio-quality, soft-minimalist Reformly Pilates Board bundled with our mobile app, offering guided workouts and a highly engaged community. Operating on a high-performing recurring subscription model, we move fast. Founded in May 2025, we generated $4.3M in international sales in our first 12 months and currently have over 3,500 active subscriptions. We are an ambitious team looking for a creative and data-driven powerhouse to take full ownership of our post-purchase customer journey. The Role: Mission To take full, autonomous ownership of Reformly’s customer lifecycle, community engagement, and visual brand communication. By blending world-class Figma design with highly persuasive copywriting, you will elevate our brand identity, drive revenue through Klaviyo and app push notifications, and foster a deeply engaged in-app community. Your ultimate goal is to proactively maximize customer Lifetime Value (LTV), reduce subscription churn, and deliver high-converting creative assets for our Meta ads, completely owning the strategy and execution from day one. Tasks & Responsibilities You will be the architect behind our customer retention and visual communication. Your core focus areas include: - Email & SMS Marketing (Klaviyo) - App Push Notifications & Lifecycle Management - Performance Ad Creation (Meta) - Brand Design & Visual Asset Creation - Community Management Expected Outcomes (First 12 Months) We measure success by hard results. In your first year, you are expected to: 1. Drive Email Revenue Growth: Increase email marketing’s contribution from 30% to 40% of the total company revenue by proactively improving automated flows, weekly campaigns, retargeting, segmentation, and overall promotional strategy. 2. Maximize Customer Lifetime Value (LTV): Increase the average LTV from $130 to $250. Achieve this by driving deep daily engagement through the app, push notifications, and targeted email sequences, ensuring customers consistently renew their 12-week subscriptions and engage with upsells. 3. Crush Subscription Churn: Reduce the overall churn rate from 18% to 12%. Take full ownership of the in-app community, optimize the post-purchase onboarding journey, and execute high-impact winback campaigns to keep users actively engaged with their Pilates board and the app. 4. Scale Meta Ads via High-Volume Creative Testing: Conceptualize, design, and launch a minimum of 5 new static Meta ad sets per week. Establish a rigorous creative testing feedback loop that consistently identifies at least 1-2 scalable "winning" creatives per month, maintaining an overall Customer Acquisition Cost (CPA) below $100 and a Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) above 1.80. Who You Are (Competencies) - Ownership & Initiative: Takes full responsibility for email performance. Does not wait for instructions, but proactively starts projects, finds opportunities, and builds systems to reach the agreed goals. - Email Marketing Expertise: Strong understanding of flows, campaigns, Klaviyo/email platforms, segmentation, retargeting, deliverability, lifecycle marketing, and A/B testing. - Conversion-Focused Figma Design: Experienced designer in Figma who can create premium, mobile-first email s that use hierarchy, spacing, visuals, CTAs, testimonials, offers, and product education to drive purchases. - Copywriting & Customer Psychology: Strong copywriter who understands hooks, subject lines, persuasion, objections, awareness stages, customer desires, and Reformly’s brand voice. Copy should feel human, sharp, and conversion-focused. - Data Analysis: Comfortable with numbers and reporting. Uses open rate, CTR, CVR, revenue per recipient, unsubscribe rate, flow performance, and customer behavior to make decisions. - Structured Execution: Organized, reliable, and able to manage a fast-moving campaign calendar, testing roadmap, flow improvements, and reporting without chaos. Our Core Values We hire, reward, and fire based on our core values. Do not apply if you do not fiercely align with these: - All-In Mentality: Cares deeply about results and wants to help build Reformly into a leading at-home Pilates and wellness brand. - Extreme Ownership: Owns outcomes fully. When email is their responsibility, the team can trust it will be handled properly. - Proactivity Over Waiting: Brings ideas, solutions, tests, and improvements without needing constant direction. - Radical Candor: Communicates directly, honestly, and clearly. Flags problems early and brings solutions. - Humble & Hungry: Ambitious, coachable, positive, and constantly looking for ways to improve themselves and the business. How to Apply We do not read standard cover letters. To apply, please submit a Video Application and your Portfolio covering the following: 1. A short introduction about yourself on video. 2. Why you are a perfect fit for this specific role and our core values. 3. A quick tour of your workspace so we can see how you structure your daily environment. 4. A link to your Figma Portfolio showcasing your best email designs, social ads, and copywriting examples. Ensure the link is set to public.

The "Look": You understand the modern "Video Essay" aesthetic. You know how to make still images dynamic (parallax) and how to explain complex data through simple, elegant animations. Attention to Detail: Timing is everything. Your edits must perfectly match the emotional beats of the voiceover. You can do your own sound design and color grading to create a cinematic atmosphere. ???? THE MANDATORY APPLICATION TEST We receive hundreds of applications from people who do not have the specific skills for this niche. To prove you are the right fit, you must complete two short 30-second test edits. We recommend to watch channels like "Fern" for inspiration. Below are the scripts. We have attached the recorded Voiceover audio files here, which are on purpose not perfect: ---------- Test 1: Storytelling & Atmosphere (ca. 30 Seconds) The Script: "May 1845. Two of the most advanced ships of their time, the HMS Erebus and Terror, set sail from England. Their goal: to conquer the Northwest Passage. They were equipped with steam engines, iron-reinforced hulls, and enough food for three years. But just two months later, they vanished into the Arctic ice. Not a single soul of the 129 crew members would ever be seen alive again. What happened in the freezing darkness?" Your Task: We want to see how you handle historical storytelling. Use archival photos, map animations, and add a subtle parallax (3D) effect to still images. When the housing bubble burst, this invisible web of debt didn't just collapse—it dragged the entire global economy down with it." Your Task: Do not use regular stock footage. description: The Opportunity: We are a rapidly growing, results-driven email marketing agency dedicated to scaling e-commerce and Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) brands (mostly based in the US). We are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Email Graphic Designer & Builder to join our dynamic remote team. This is a critical role for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at transforming strategic briefs into high-converting, visually compelling email campaigns, and can efficiently manage a rapid design-to-build workflow. Key Responsibilities: - Based on the provided scope, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following core services: - Rapid Email Design & Build: Design and build visually stunning, mobile-responsive email s with efficiency, ensuring a quick turnaround time of 24–48 hours for most tasks within the set due date. - Upload the email designs from Figma to Klaviyo templates - Volume: Design 6-10 email s per day according to a task list that the Project Manager will provide you with. - Team Collaboration: Actively interface and collaborate with Project Managers, Strategists, and other tea ---------- mbers to ensure designs are on-brand and align with client objectives. - Workflow Management: Proactively manage tasks, assets, and communication using our core platforms, including the Notion workspace and Slack channels, to deliver the best possible service to the agency and its assigned clients. - Quality & Compliance: Strictly adhere to all provided training guides, best practices, and established design/QA protocols. - Communication & Availability: Report to the Project Manager via Slack during work days. Work Schedule & Professional Development: Availability: The role requires general availability to provide services and engage with the team during normal US or EU business hours (EST or CEST): Monday – Friday, 9:00 am – 5:00 pm Commitment to Growth: You are expected to make best efforts to continually develop the skill sets involved in this role. Core Responsibilities - Edit TikTok and Reels content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time, not just aesthetics - Watch back your past edits and apply learnings to the new ones, constantly improving. - Collaborate with the marketing team to test new creative angles and iterate on what's working - Turn around content quickly and communicate clearly on timelines, no constant check-ins required - Be constantly aware of new TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them to Exchange Life's videos where relevant. Must-Haves - At least one TikTok or Reel that crossed 500K views in the last 2 months, and you can explain what made it work - Portfolio of 10+ short-form edits (TikTok or Reels only) from the last 30 days - Owns their output, takes feedback and internalizes it, and doesn't repeat the same mistakes - Able to look at metrics like hook rate, retention, watch time, and understand what you can improve on to make the video better - Proficient in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool - Clear written and spoken English communication and ability to work independently Nice-to-Haves - Experience editing content for e-commerce brands - Familiarity with adapting to new TikTok formats and making iterations on past videos Not a Fit If - Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content - You can't point to a recent viral video and explain why it performed - You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive - You're looking for a short-term project Compensation & Working Style - Base rate: 1220 PHP / hr - Hours: ~35 hrs / week - Schedule: Fully flexible, work whenever you want, as long as you meet deadlines - Bonuses: Uncapped, performance-based, paid for views and ad spend - Working style: no micromanagement This is a long-term role. title: Part-Time Canva Designer and Short Video Editor for Premium Children’s Brand
job_title: Part-Time Canva Designer and Short Video Editor for Premium Children’s Brand
description: Job Description: I’m looking for a creative, reliable and detail-oriented part-time Canva Designer and Short Video Editor from the Philippines to help create weekly social media content for Organicline, a premium children’s clothing brand based in Australia. Organicline creates soft, clean and premium childrenswear content for Instagram, Facebook and ---------- . The brand style is warm, calm, minimal, modern and child-friendly. This is not a full social media strategy role. I provide the weekly direction, product focus, raw materials, captions, hooks, brand rules, software direction and creative guidance. Your role is to turn those materials into polished, premium-looking weekly content. I’m looking for someone with strong taste, good attention to detail and a real ability to make short videos feel alive, beautiful and scroll-stopping. What You Will Create Each Week: The regular weekly package includes: 14 Reels or short vertical videos Captions and hashtags Basic quality checking before delivery Final files prepared clearly for publishing Possible scheduling support through Meta Business Suite All videos must be vertical 9:16. Video content is very important for this role. Please do not apply if you only want to make static Canva graphics. What I Provide: I provide: Weekly content plan Product direction Raw Organicline photos and videos Brand rules Caption and hook guidance Creative direction Feedback and examples You do not need to invent the full strategy from zero. But you must be creative in how you bring the content to life. AI-Assisted Video Work: A key part of this role is turning existing Organicline photos, product images and short clips into premium 9:16 Reels. You should be comfortable using editing, motion, music, text overlays and, where appropriate, AI-assisted image-to-video tools such as Runway, Kling, Pika or similar. The final result must look natural, premium and realistic. We do not want obvious AI effects, distorted children, warped clothing, strange faces, fake scenes or cheap-looking edits. AI tools should support the final content. They should not make the brand look fake. What I Need From You: You must be able to: Create clean Canva graphics Edit short-form videos in Filmora, CapCut or a similar tool Turn still images and product assets into premium Reels Use pacing, movement, cropping, music and text to make videos more engaging Read instructions carefully Check English text before using it Notice if something sounds wrong, too technical or not suitable for public posting Ask questions before delivering anything unclear Avoid careless copy-paste mistakes Keep files organised Meet weekly deadlines Communicate clearly Nice To Have: Experience with children’s brands Experience with fashion or ecommerce content Experience with Runway AI, Kling, Pika or similar tools Experience with Meta Business Suite Experience creating TikTok, Instagram Reels or Meta ad creatives Brand Style: Organicline content should feel: Premium Soft Clean Warm Modern Natural Child-friendly Calm, but not boring Avoid loud colours, messy layouts, cheap templates, heavy effects or overdesigned graphics. The content should feel like a beautiful Australian children’s brand, not a random social media template. Quality Standards: I’m looking for someone who cares about the final result. Content must look premium. Text must be readable. Spelling must be checked. Video must not look lazy or random. AI clips must look natural. No strange motion, glitches or distorted children. No text covering a child’s face or important product detail. No public captions that sound like internal production notes. Every post must be checked before delivery because this is public brand content. Compensation: This is a small, clear, part-time weekly role. Paid test task: 15 USD Trial week: 50 USD After successful trial: 60 to 75 USD per week Organicline is still a growing brand. I’m looking for a long-term working relationship with the right person. As the brand grows, compensation may be reviewed in the future, based on consistency, quality, reliability and the level of content delivered. This role is for someone efficient. The weekly plan and materials are provided, so the work is mainly creative assembly, design, video editing and checking. Selection Process: Step 1: Send your application with portfolio examples. Step 2: Shortlisted applicants complete a small paid test task. Step 3: Best applicant completes a paid trial week. Step 4: Long-term weekly work begins if the trial goes well. The paid test task will ask you to create one outstanding 20 to 30 second vertical Reel from provided Organicline photos and assets. The goal is not just to animate a photo. The goal is to make the brand feel more alive, premium and scroll-stopping while keeping the product and child looking natural. Confidentiality And IP: Before receiving broader access to Organicline materials, the selected applicant will need to sign a simple Confidentiality and IP Agreement. All work created for Organicline will belong to Organicline. Organicline images, videos, children’s photos, product materials, brand documents and briefs must not be shared, reused or added to a portfolio without written permission. How To Apply: Please send: A short introduction about you. A link to your portfolio. At least 3 examples of short-form videos you created. At least 3 examples of Canva graphics, carousel designs or social media posts. Your experience with Canva. Your experience with Filmora, CapCut or similar video editing tools. Your experience with AI-assisted video tools, if any. How many hours you think you would need to complete the weekly package. The word “cotton” at the start of your message, so I know you read the full post. Please also answer these questions: What makes a children’s clothing brand look premium on Instagram? How would you turn simple product photos into a beautiful 20 to 30 second Reel? What would you do if a caption or text I gave you sounded too technical or not suitable for public posting? Applications without video examples will not be considered. I’m looking for a long-term working relationship with the right person.

Ability to follow instructions Creative briefs need to be followed carefully. Clear communication You should be responsive during your scheduled hours and proactive when you are stuck or behind. Openness to feedback You should be comfortable receiving feedback and improving your work. Skills and experience • Figma design experience • Static ad design experience • Ecommerce design experience • Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator experience is a bonus • Strong layout and typography skills • Strong written English • Ability to work from creative briefs • Organized file management • Reliable communication Bonus if you have experience with: • Meta/Facebook ad creatives • Direct response design • Facebook Ad Library research • Creative strategy • Email design • Landing page design • AI creative tools • Shopify assets • Klaviyo email design Experience matters less than taste, speed, reliability, and willingness to learn.
